tei:div.tei:p: 1$0000250bla ma'i thugs sgrub bar chad kun sel las 'jam dpal pha rol rgol 'joms kyi brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs bzhugs so/1$0000300 khyab bdag kun bzang 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed// gsang bdag dpa' bo gnod sbyin skar mda' gdong*// bstan pa'i dbu brnyes rgyal po dzaḥgasum la// gsol ba 'debs so phyogs las rnam rgyal shog /'jam dpal bshes gnyen rombu gu hya rje// shāntiṃ garbha padma thod phreng rtsal/ kha thun nag po gtsug lag dpal dge la// gsol ba 'debs so phyogs las rnam rgyal shog /du har nag po sangs rgyas gsang ba dang*// bā su dhā ra sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs// bdud 'dul rgyal po mnga' bdag yab sras la// gsol ba 'debs so phyogs las rnam rgyal shog /padma'i rgyal tshab mchog gyur bde chen gling*// bka' babs chos bdag rtsa brgyud bla ma'i tshogs// 'jam dpal zhi khro'i dkyil 'khor 'khor lo la// gsol ba 'debs so phyogs las rnam rgyal shog /lhar snang brtan pos srid gsum zil gyis gnon// drag sngags nus pas bdud bgegs thal bar brlag /ting 'dzin stobs kyis las chen bcu gnyis dang*// dngos grub rnam gnyis bde blag 'grub par shog /mi kha byad phur dus min 'chi ba sogs// nyes pa'i tshang tshing mthu stobs dus mtha'i mes// lhag med bcom nas 'chi bdag bdud kyi dpung*// mthar byed 'jam dpal khros pa'i sku brnyes shog /'khor lo rnam bzhir goms pa'i rtsal rdzogs nas// rang rig 'jam dpal gzhon nu snying dbus sad// sgrib gnyis g.yul las rnam par rgyal ba yis// gsang chen rdo rje'i 'khor los sgyur byed shog /
ces pa 'di ni lha mchog 'di nyid la mos pa'i blo can karma nyi mas gsung bskul ngor/ padma gar gyi dbang phyug rtsal gyis bris pa dge legs 'phel/// /
